newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Computer problems delay Seoul stock futures trade.
newsitem.headline: Computer problems delay Seoul stock futures trade.

text.p: Stock index futures trading on the Seoul stock market began 20 minutes later than usual because of computer problems at several brokerages, the Korea Stock Exchange said.
The trading opened at 9:50 a.m. (0050 GMT).
Despite the delayed opening, other trading hours will not be affected, an exchange spokesman said.
He did not name the brokerage houses in which computer problems occurred.
The futures March contracts were trading at 68.20, up 0.60 points on the day.
